problems.name: One-shot generation with no execution feedback: empty/incorrect drafts (wrong literal values, wrong join keys, wrong projected columns) are returned unchecked

attempts.what: Add a draft-then-verify loop: execute the first SQL via env.execute and, if it errors or returns 0 rows, make a second policy call that includes the error/empty result plus sampled distinct values of the string columns referenced in the question/hint, so the model can fix lite...
